name: 1999 Coca-Cola/Meijer Notre Dame: A Century of Greatness

cards.p: 1988: Notre Dame defeats top-ranked Miami 31-30
1979: Montana throws TD as time expires in Cotton Bowl win over Houston
1993: Irish defeat top-rated Florida State 31-24
1928: Notre Dame defeats Army 12-6 behind Rockne’s “Gipper” speech
1977: Irish don green jerseys, defeat fifth-rated USC 49-19
1935: Notre Dame knocks off Ohio State in “Game of the Century”
1989: Raghib Ismail returns two kickoffs for TDs as Irish beat #2 Michigan
1924: Grantland Rice christens Four Horsemen after 13-7 win over Army
1966: Irish and Michigan State end epic matchup in 10-10 ties
1973: Notre Dame prevails 24-23 in Sugar Bowl game against #1 Alabama
1957: Notre Dame’s 7-0 win ends Oklahoma’s record 47-game win streak
1987: Tim Brown returns two punts for TDs as Irish beat Michigan State
1992: Mirer throws for two-point conversion to beat Penn State in the snow
1913: Rockne and Dorais popularize forward pass in 35-13 Irish win at Army
1946: Notre Dame and Army battle to 0-0 tie at Yankee Stadium
1978: Irish knock off top-rated Texas in Cotton Bowl to claim #1 spot
1989: Defeat of #3 West Virginia 34-21 in Fiesta Bowl to clinch national title
1975: Notre Dame holds off #1 Alabama in Orange Bowl in Ara’s last game
1980: Oliver’s 51-yard field goal as time expires beats Michigan
1992: Bettis’ second-half runs enable Irish to beat Florida in Sugar Bowl
